comment:
The fifth attenuverter and CV jack are marked NOISE on the panel, and both are wired to the Noise Length parameter, whose knob the panel prints as TAIL (Impact.cpp:303, widget order at Impact.cpp:459-467 and 493-501). The NOISE knob itself has no CV input at all. The manual repeats the panel's grouping — 'Each of Decay, Punch, Morph, Noise and Fold has an attenuverter for its CV input' — which is wrong for the Noise pair.

The panel prints DRUM over the engine switch and harsh beneath it; the manual and the maker's tooltip both call it Mode. The manual lists the noise types as Rumble, Crunch and Dust without saying which way up they sit: value 0, the bottom position, is Rumble (Impact.cpp:140, 305).

In Harsh mode the carrier is wavefolded twice — once at Impact.cpp:354 and again at Impact.cpp:401 when the body is folded — so FOLD bites harder there than in Pure mode.

The drum stops of its own accord ten seconds after a trigger (Impact.cpp:407) and both outputs are held at 0V until the next one.
